title: Sparkly flower pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g>
    <!-- Sparkle top left -->
    <polygon points="18,18 20,23 25,25 20,27 18,32 16,27 11,25 16,23" fill="#FFE066"/>
    <!-- Sparkle top right -->
    <polygon points="82,12 84,16 88,18 84,20 82,24 80,20 76,18 80,16" fill="#FFE066"/>
    <!-- Sparkle mid left -->
    <polygon points="8,55 10,58 13,60 10,62 8,65 6,62 3,60 6,58" fill="#FFD54F"/>
    <!-- Sparkle mid right -->
    <polygon points="92,50 94,53 97,55 94,57 92,60 90,57 87,55 90,53" fill="#FFD54F"/>
    <!-- Sparkle small top center -->
    <polygon points="50,8 51,11 54,12 51,13 50,16 49,13 46,12 49,11" fill="#FFF59D"/>
    <!-- Small sparkle left -->
    <polygon points="14,38 15,40 17,41 15,42 14,44 13,42 11,41 13,40" fill="#FFE082"/>
    <!-- Small sparkle right -->
    <polygon points="86,35 87,37 89,38 87,39 86,41 85,39 83,38 85,37" fill="#FFE082"/>
    <!-- Small dot sparkles -->
    <circle cx="25" cy="45" r="1.5" fill="#FFF176"/>
    <circle cx="75" cy="42" r="1.5" fill="#FFF176"/>
    <circle cx="35" cy="12" r="1.5" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
    <circle cx="65" cy="15" r="1.5" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Flowers -->
  <!-- Stem left -->
  <rect x="42" y="22" width="3" height="28" rx="1.5" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <!-- Stem right -->
  <rect x="55" y="25" width="3" height="25" rx="1.5" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <!-- Stem center -->
  <rect x="48.5" y="18" width="3" height="32" rx="1.5" fill="#66BB6A"/>

  <!-- Leaves -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="40" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#66BB6A" transform="rotate(-30 38 40)"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="38" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#66BB6A" transform="rotate(25 62 38)"/>

  <!-- Flower left -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="42" cy="20" r="5" fill="#FF7043"/>
    <circle cx="37" cy="18" r="4.5" fill="#FF8A65"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="18" r="4.5" fill="#FF8A65"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="14" r="4.5" fill="#FFAB91"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="20" r="2.5" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Flower right -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="57" cy="22" r="5" fill="#AB47BC"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="20" r="4.5" fill="#CE93D8"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="20" r="4.5" fill="#CE93D8"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="16" r="4.5" fill="#E1BEE7"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="22" r="2.5" fill="#FFE082"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Flower center -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="50" cy="15" r="5" fill="#EF5350"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="13" r="4" fill="#EF9A9A"/>
    <circle cx="55" cy="13" r="4" fill="#EF9A9A"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="9" r="4" fill="#FFCDD2"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="15" r="2.5" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Pot rim -->
  <rect x="32" y="48" width="36" height="8" rx="2" fill="#D97706"/>
  <!-- Pot rim highlight -->
  <rect x="32" y="48" width="36" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#F59E0B"/>

  <!-- Pot body -->
  <path d="M35,56 L65,56 L62,80 Q61,84 58,84 L42,84 Q39,84 38,80 Z" fill="#B45309"/>
  <!-- Pot body highlight left -->
  <path d="M35,56 L40,56 L38,80 Q38,84 40,84 L38,84 Q39,84 38,80 Z" fill="#D97706"/>
  <!-- Pot body shadow right -->
  <path d="M65,56 L60,56 L58,80 Q58,84 56,84 L58,84 Q61,84 62,80 Z" fill="#92400E"/>

  <!-- Pot bottom rim -->
  <rect x="38" y="82" width="24" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#A16207"/>
  <rect x="38" y="82" width="24" height="2" rx="1" fill="#CA8A04"/>

  <!-- Soil -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="14" ry="4" fill="#5D4037"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="49.5" rx="13" ry="3" fill="#6D4C41"/>

  <!-- Small soil dots -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="50" r="1" fill="#4E342E"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="49.5" r="1" fill="#4E342E"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="51" r="0.8" fill="#4E342E"/>
</svg>
